acceptanceCriteria: Prove canonical fixture and ordinary readLeaseProof succeeds before fault injection.

body: Suspected preexisting cleanup-error masking identified during #494 review; not repaired by current lease-write optimization. DD8 internal/tasks/store/lease_read.go:39 assigns err=moved after leaseAudit returns, then SNAPSHOT_MOVED retries. This can discard a prior audit failure if movement co-occurs; actual file-close+dirty-guard readLeaseProof injection NOT_RUN. #494 preserves ordinary wrapper AuditForWrite; its new separate fatal cleanup channel applies optimized write preparation only. Installed Core163 Tasks202. Dedup dirty-guard zero at2473. Expected fatal resource cleanup failure survives changed-guard retry decision; actual static assignment suggests lost provenance, pending reproduction.
title: Investigate readLeaseProof dirty guard masking audit cleanup errors
